slug: 2025-07-15 Zimbabwe looks forward to digital ID rollout after population registry reform

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that Zimbabwe upgraded its national population registry in a reform begun around 2023 and concluded by mid-2025.
Biometric Update reports the upgraded national population registry was linked up with other important services to facilitate access, and that an integrated digital system will be based on it.

The Herald reports ZPRS is the official platform that stores and manages demographic data of all Zimbabwean citizens, including name, date of birth, sex, nationality, marital status, place of birth and residence, and national ID number, with an upgrade being finalised.

note: The document states nothing on this study's aspects for this country that the study's questions ask.

facts.fact: The Sunday Mail reports the Zimbabwe Population Registry System, a central database of citizens' demographic data, is in final testing and due to be implemented from July 2024, per Minister Kazembe.

The Herald reports that the Zimbabwe Population Registration System (ZPRS) is a centralised database storing citizens' demographic information, described by Minister Kazembe at a July 2026 registrars' meeting.

The Herald reports ZPRS has been integrated with the Department of Immigration's fully operational Online Border Management System (OBMS), and that linking it to police is under way, per the minister.
The Herald quotes Minister Kazembe saying the Zimbabwe Population Registry System centralises national data and the Registrar-General has records of everyone.
Minister Kazembe says the system updates automatically and in real time on death registration and when citizens reach voting age.

note: Document is a UNDP request for proposal (UNDP-ZWE-02188, 2026-11-13) for technical assistance to integrate an existing shared health record and core registries with an HIE layer; it states no delivered system, figure or status for this study's aspects, and a tender is not the thing delivered.
